7. Removing an edge only costs capacity. If false, a missing sibling or direct route raises an edit's value because this edit becomes the main supplier (#9, #11, #19).
8. The stem edge 0 can be edited independently of the output-side routes. If false, direct bypasses or parallel routes change how risky an edit on edge 0 is (#16, #17).
